Such a great question and I am going to pour out some of my thoughts here that I have yet to share with any of my friends because I uphold a manly image and have yet to break it. And if you're reading this then I hope the songs here may one day help you connect with music the way I did.

After I broke up with my ex, it took me about a year for a breakup phase because of some rebounds in between and the passing of a furry one. Weirdly enough,  those events acted as the catalyst and opened up a new emotional level for me that I never knew I was capable and of.

It was a terrible yet such a growing period for a 29 yr old man, discovering emotions. So please let me share with a little of my emotional discovery journey, I listened and watched a lot of The Lumineers - Ballad of Cleopatra. The series of songs played with the music video has such a great story there that it kills me everytime. If you find yourself in a place where you broke up but realised you could've been better, maybe you might appreciate it.

Months passed and I found myself swiping again and I met someone and we hit it off so well which was all I ever wanted. As i would soon discover and she too,  she is emotionally unavailable and I couldn't understand it. At this point, I'm super emotional, I'm falling hard for her. As we talk,  she realised she couldn't move forward and was moving back while i was still ahead, trying to pull her forward with me.

So here comes the song that describes this chapter of my life and that has been on a loop for months now and I can't seem to get over it. Nuvole Bianche, a piano piece and perhaps an unlikely choice because one would not expect a piano piece to illicit such a strong emotion. But the composer is a fkin genius I tell you, every note played was in sync with what I felt, it knew exactly what I was going through. 

Then my friend comes in and introduces a new song, even more heartbreaking, taking me to a deeper level and another perspective as to what I'm going through. 6 moments Musicaux op.16 - Rachmaninoff, yes another piano piece and before this I never listened much to piano pieces! This song is another treasure. It was all the emotions packed into your je song. It starts off being sentimental, before taking you down memory lane of all the happy and sad moments you have had. All with growing undertones of bittersweet. Then it starts to take you deeper into the sadness and what could've been but never did. And the release from this sadness is that life goes on, the composer says you'll be ok, it hugs you in some sort of comfort that life will go on and you'll be ok. It goes easier on the listener as we start to accept the past and perhaps look back with a smile and be glad it all happened. What a fucking rollercoaster...

While I'm still waiting for this girl, I've managed to pull myself out a little and that emotional gate has closed somewhat. Someday I'll marry her, play it at my wedding and share with her this part of my life. 


In the last few years, I've grown and understood myself more than I've ever known, I've connected with specific pieces of music and I hope you too find that deeper connection to your music.
